question: In the frozen first-birth 10 s natural contact stream, does matched generic Base substrate versus Born P1 show repeatable ERB-time character across the same 44 parent FOOT_CONTACT groups, or mostly level difference, group-versus-foot semantics, and overlap?

decision.rationale: The native fixed-gain level gap is large, but unit-sum shape comparisons remain dissimilar across 100/250/500 ms windows. Cross-event shape-change patterns are only partly consistent, and the matched event semantics and dense late-window overlap prevent a clean general Base-versus-Born character claim.

implementationFacts: Reanalyzed only the existing frozen generic Base parent-group raw worklet stem and Born P1 raw worklet stem.
Base contains one event per 44 unique FOOT_CONTACT groups; Born contains 63 accepted P1 foot strikes mapped to those same parent groups.
Base generic worklet randomness realization was not recorded; no replay was used to replace the verified historical PCM.
All windows use the common requested parent event sample as anchor. The Base arm's recorded next-128-frame dispatch is retained as metadata and is not shifted out of the measured response.

overlapRelationship.scope: descriptive only; windows are not isolated and event pairs overlap
descriptive only; windows are not isolated and event pairs overlap
descriptive only; windows are not isolated and event pairs overlap

crossEventShapeEffectConsistency500ms.definition: cosine between event-wise (Born unit-sum ERB-time power minus Base unit-sum ERB-time power) vectors; descriptive cross-event pattern consistency

representation.linearPower: one-sided |rFFT|^2 / sum(Hann)^2, positive bins doubled except DC; sum bin powers into [low,high) ERB bands before any dB conversion
representation.stereoPooling: mean left/right linear ERB power per time-band cell
representation.shapeOnly: divide each response ERB-time linear power by that response's total ERB-time power; compare cosine, integrated profile and late-half integrated profile; no floor enters shape normalization

emptyBands.reason: no FFT bin center falls in this half-open band

representation.boundaryRule: half-open [low,high); DC included in first band; bin centers through 7968.75 Hz
representation.windowFramePolicy: each complete PCM segment is analyzed at its exact full length; left-aligned frames; helper zero-pads final partial frame

eventCountAndOverlap.otherEventDefinition: count of other parent-group requested anchors / mapped Born accepted strikes whose start lies in [current anchor, current anchor + duration), excluding the current contact group

validation.windowPolicy: whole windows only; no truncation; aligned at common parent requestedFrame; actual Base 128-frame dispatch offset is separately retained
validation.stereoPooling: mean of left and right linear ERB power per time-band cell
validation.fixedGainNormalization: none; unit-sum normalization appears only in explicitly named shape-only metrics

interpretationLimits: This compares these frozen raw stems, not a randomized population or a new render.
Generic Base uses one group-level excitation per parent contact; Born P1 uses accepted individual foot responses. This event semantic difference is part of the historical stems.
Window metrics include overlap from the continuous streams; event windows are not isolated.
Shape-only unit-sum metrics describe distribution shape and do not establish audibility.
No human listening assessment was performed; no audibility, preference, or production-quality claim is made.
